title: "Software"

Open-source packages I am a collaborator on.

## [Superb.jl](https://github.com/JuliaSmoothOptimizers/Superb.jl)

A Julia implementation of Superb (Gould–Orban–Toint, 2003), an interior-point
ℓ₁-penalty method for nonlinear optimization, built NCL-style on the
[JuliaSmoothOptimizers](https://jso.dev) ecosystem. I am its most active contributor:
I added Ipopt, MadNLP and Knitro subsolvers, NLPModels derivative and dimension tests,
and support for Julia LTS.

## [Qiskit.jl](https://github.com/Qiskit/Qiskit.jl)

Julia bindings for [Qiskit](https://www.ibm.com/quantum/qiskit) through its C API.
I added a `TranspileOptions` wrapper, `add_instruction` and `add_property` on `Target`,
a `delay` method on `QuantumCircuit` with [Unitful.jl](https://github.com/PainterQubits/Unitful.jl)
units, readable `show` methods for wrapped C objects, and minimum-version testing of
dependencies, and fixed memory cleanup in `count_ops`.

## [TagBot](https://github.com/JuliaRegistries/TagBot)

The GitHub Action that creates tags, releases and changelogs for Julia packages when
they are registered, used across the Julia ecosystem. I have had over 20 pull requests
merged, including changelog support for backport and yanked releases, a
`changelog_format` option, correct handling of Registrator branches and subdirectory
packages, case-insensitive registry lookups, and clearer error handling for rate limits,
permissions and malformed TOML.

## [QiOpt4QNet-Simulator](https://github.com/Sguy1908/QiOpt4QNet-Simulator)

A quantum-network simulation and optimization framework. It models repeater networks with
limited quantum memory and noisy links, builds candidate route and purification bundles
for service requests, and compares exact MILP, QUBO and quantum annealing,
tensor-network and classical heuristic solvers for admitting them. I am the top
contributor: I added the Metropolis annealer and tensor-network optimizer, a
conflict-aware purification scheduler, joint scheduling, adaptive-QUBO and GNN
extensions, and the CI setup.
